title: Care Management
description: Care Management documentation for Practice Caregiver.
overview: This guide covers care management workflows for Practice Caregiver.

subtasks.title: Follow Up Query
subtasks.purpose: Identify patients due for follow-up based on program, provider, caregiver, and status filters.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Open Care Mgmt → Follow Up Query — the filter form loads with Last / First Name, Program Enrolled (required), Provider, Caregiver, and Status.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Set Program Enrolled and any narrowing filters, then click Query — the grid renders #, Status, Vitals, Name, Systolic, Diastolic, Pulse, Glucose, Weight, Last Upload, # Readings, Time, and Action.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use Action buttons on a row to open the patient chart and complete or reschedule the follow-up.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Click Reset to clear filters. The empty state message “Select filters and click Query to load patients” confirms no query has been run yet.
